scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact optimal forward shadowing error for a three-parameter, piecewise affine self-map of [0,2] under the explicit small-error condition; independently validated proof is not claimed. A rational finite-prefix checker corroborates, but cannot certify, the universal theorem. Does not cover arbitrary nonlinear or bilateral pseudotrajectories.
title: Sharp linear shadowing for one-way affine interval gateways
